text: Explain the operational distinctions and cache implications between an array-based contiguous queue and a pointer-based linked queue.
Apply Dijkstra's single-source shortest path algorithm on a directed weighted graph with edge weights strictly positive. Tabulate distance estimates at each relaxation step.
Demonstrate the execution of Radix Sort on an unsorted list of 8 3-digit keys. Detail the intermediate bucket distributions for each significant digit pass.
Analyze why hash table rehashing requires rehashing every entry rather than simply doubling the underlying array size. Formulate the amortized cost per insertion.
Deconstruct how a red-black tree preserves O(log n) worst-case search bounds using node coloring rules following successive red child violations.
Critique and evaluate whether a Min-Heap can efficiently support decrease-key operations in O(log n) time without maintaining an auxiliary positional hash index.
Evaluate the correctness of Tarjan's strongly connected components algorithm compared to Kosaraju's two-pass DFS approach under strict single-pass graph streaming conditions.
Design and synthesize an augmented Interval Tree that maintains the maximum endpoint across subtrees, enabling overlap queries in O(k log n) time.
